segments.tr: Consulte a su intercambio, un profesional con licencia o un asesor fiscal sobre su situación específica.*

ar.title: التسجيل المفتوح لقانون الرعاية الميسرة (ACA) لعام 2027 يبدأ في 1 نوفمبر: كيف يمكن للأقساط والإعانات والشرائح المعدنية تغيير فاتورتك الشهرية

segments.src: Open enrollment for 2027 Affordable Care Act (ACA) Marketplace coverage begins November 1.
segments.tr: تبدأ فترة التسجيل المفتوح لتغطية سوق قانون الرعاية الميسرة (ACA) لعام 2027 في 1 نوفمبر.

segments.src: Shoppers on HealthCare.gov and in state-based exchanges will soon be able to see next year's plans and prices.
segments.tr: سيتمكن المتسوقون على موقع HealthCare.gov وفي التبادلات القائمة على الولاية قريبًا من رؤية خطط وأسعار العام المقبل.

segments.src: For many households, the monthly premium will depend on three things: the sticker price of the plan, the amount of financial help they qualify for, and the metal tier they choose.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للعديد من الأسر، سيعتمد القسط الشهري على ثلاثة أمور: السعر المعلن للخطة، ومقدار المساعدة المالية التي مؤهلون لها، والشريئة المعدنية التي يختارونها.

segments.src: This explainer walks through each of those pieces and lists what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا المقال كل جزء من هذه الأجزاء ويسرد ما يجب مقارنته قبل الموعد النهائي.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: هذه معلومات عامة وليست نصيحة مالية أو تأمينية شخصية.

segments.src: Rules, dates and prices vary by state and by household, so confirm details on your own exchange.
segments.tr: تختلف القواعد والتواريخ والأسعار حسب الولاية وحسب الأسرة، لذا تأكد من التفاصيل على التبادل الخاص بك.

segments.src: ## Why this enrollment season is different
segments.tr: ## لماذا يختلف موسم التسجيل هذا

segments.src: Starting with the 2026 plan year, the enhanced premium tax credits that Congress put in place in 2021 and later extended were scheduled to expire.
segments.tr: بدءًا من سنة الخطط لعام 2026، كان مقررًا أن تنتهي صلاحية الإعفاءات الضريبية المعززة للأقساط التي وضعها الكونغرس في عام 2021 وتم تمديدها لاحقًا.

segments.src: Those enhanced credits had done two main things:
segments.tr: أدت تلك الإعفاءات المعززة إلى أمرين رئيسيين:

segments.src: - They lowered the share of income that many enrollees were expected to pay toward a benchmark plan.
segments.tr: - لقد خفضت حصة الدخل التي كان متوقعًا أن يدفعها العديد من المشتركين نحو خطة معيارية.

segments.src: - They removed the "subsidy cliff" at 400% of the federal poverty level, so higher-income households could still qualify for help if the benchmark plan cost more than a set percentage of their income.
segments.tr: - لقد أزالوا "منحدر الإعانة" عند 400% من مستوى الفقر الفيدرالي، بحيث لا تزال الأسر ذات الدخل الأرفع مؤهلة للحصول على المساعدة إذا كانت تكلفة الخطة المعيارية أعلى من نسبة محددة من دخلها.

segments.src: When the enhanced credits lapse, the original ACA subsidy structure applies.
segments.tr: عندما تنتهي صلاحية الإعفاءات المعززة، يتم تطبيق هيكل إعانة قانون الرعاية الميسرة (ACA) الأصلي.

segments.src: Under that structure, the expected contribution rises for most enrollees, and households above 400% of the poverty level generally receive no premium tax credit at all.
segments.tr: بموجب هذا الهيكل، ترتفع المساهمة المتوقعة لمعظم المشتركين، وعادة لا تتلقى الأسر التي تزيد عن 400% من مستوى الفقر أي إعفاء ضريبي للقسط على الإطلاق.

segments.src: Whether lawmakers change these rules again is a policy question that can shift quickly, so check the current federal guidance and your exchange's notices rather than relying on last year's numbers.
segments.tr: ما إذا كان المشرعون يغيرون هذه القواعد مرة أخرى هو سؤال سياسي يمكن أن يتغير بسرعة، لذا تحقق من التوجيهات الفيدرالية الحالية وإشعارات التبادل الخاص بك بدلاً من الاعتماد على أرقام العام الماضي.

segments.src: ## How 2027 premiums are set
segments.tr: ## كيف يتم تحديد أقساط عام 2027

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates with state regulators, who review them before final prices are published.
segments.tr: تقوم شركات التأمين بتقديم الأسعار المقترحة لمسؤولي التنظيم في الولاية، الذين يراجعونها قبل نشر الأسعار النهائية.

segments.src: Several factors typically push rates up or down:
segments.tr: تدفع عدة عوامل عادةً الأسعار صعودًا أو هبوطًا:

segments.src: - **Medical costs and utilization.** Hospital prices, prescription drug spending and how often people use care all feed into rate requests.
segments.tr: - **التكاليف الطبية والاستخدام.** أسعار المستشفيات، وإنفاق الأدوية الموصوفة، ومدى تكرار استخدام الأشخاص للرعاية، كلها تغذي طلبات الأسعار.

segments.src: - **Who enrolls.** If healthier people leave the market because subsidies shrink, the remaining pool can be costlier on average, which insurers may reflect in prices.
segments.tr: - **من يقوم بالاشتراك.** إذا غادر الأشخاص الأصحاء السوق بسبب تقلص الإعانات، فقد تكون مجموعة المتبقيين أكثر تكلفة في المتوسط، وهو ما قد تعكسه شركات التأمين في الأسعار.

segments.src: - **Regulatory changes.** Federal and state rules on eligibility, verification and enrollment periods can affect how many people sign up.
segments.tr: - **التغييرات التنظيمية.** يمكن أن تؤثر القواعد الفيدرالية وقواعد الولاية بشأن أهلية التحقق وفترات التسجيل على عدد الأشخاص الذين يسجلون.

segments.src: - **Local competition.** Counties with several insurers often see more stable prices than counties with only one or two.
segments.tr: - **المنافسة المحلية.** تشهد المقاطعات التي بها عدة شركات تأمين أسعارًا أكثر استقرارًا غالبًا مقارنة بالمقاطعات التي تحتوي على شركة تأمين واحدة أو اثنتين فقط.

segments.src: Because these factors are local, the change you see can differ a lot from a neighbor's in another county or state.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن هذه العوامل محلية، فإن التغيير الذي تراه يمكن أن يختلف كثيرًا عن جارك في مقاطعة أو ولاية أخرى.

segments.src: The average increase reported in the news may not match your own.
segments.tr: قد لا تتطابق الزيادة المتوسطة المبلغ عنها في الأخبار مع زيادتك الخاصة.

segments.src: ## Sticker price versus what you actually pay
segments.tr: ## السعر المعلن مقابل ما تدفعه فعليًا

segments.src: The price listed for a plan is not always what a household pays.
segments.tr: السعر المدرج للخطة ليس بالضرورة ما تدفعه الأسرة.

segments.src: If you qualify for a premium tax credit, the credit is based on the cost of the second-lowest-cost Silver plan in your area, known as the benchmark plan, and on your income.
segments.tr: إذا كنت مؤهلاً للحصول على إعفاء ضريبي للقسط، يعتمد الإعفاء على تكلفة خطة الفضة الأقل تكلفة ثانية في منطقتك، والمعروفة بالخطة المعيارية، وعلى دخلك.

segments.src: In simple terms:
segments.tr: بكلمات بسيطة:

segments.src: 1. The government estimates how much you should contribute toward the benchmark plan, as a percentage of your household income.
segments.tr: 1. تقدر الحكومة مقدار ما يجب عليك المساهمة به نحو الخطة المعيارية، كنسبة مئوية من دخل أسرتك.

segments.src: 2. The tax credit covers the rest of the benchmark's cost.
segments.tr: 2. يغطي الإعفاء الضريبي بقية تكلفة الخطة المعيارية.

segments.src: 3. You can apply that credit to any Marketplace plan, though you pay the difference if you choose a plan priced above the benchmark.
segments.tr: 3. يمكنك تطبيق هذا الإعفاء على أي خطة في السوق، رغم أنك تدفع الفرق إذا اخترت خطة بسعر أعلى من الخطة المعيارية.

segments.src: This means that when the benchmark premium rises, a subsidized household may see little change in its own payment, while an unsubsidized household bears the full increase.
segments.tr: هذا يعني أنه عندما ترتفع قسط الخطة المعيارية، قد ترى الأسرة الحاصلة على إعانة تغيرًا طفيفًا في دفعاتها الخاصة، بينما تتحمل الأسرة غير الحاصلة على إعانة الزيادة الكاملة.

segments.src: It also means that a change in the subsidy formula can change your bill even if your plan's price stays flat.
segments.tr: يعني هذا أيضًا أن تغييرًا في صيغة الإعانة يمكن أن يغير فاتورتك حتى لو ظل سعر خطتك ثابتًا.

segments.tr: ### توضيح بسيط

segments.tr: الأرقام أدناه مصطنعة لإظهار الآلية.

segments.tr: إنها ليست توقعات.

segments.src: Even with a larger credit, the family pays $50 more per month.
segments.tr: حتى مع إعانة أكبر، تدفع العائلة $50 إضافية شهريًا.

segments.src: Your own result depends on your income, ages, location and the plans available.
segments.tr: تعتمد نتيجتك الخاصة على دخلك، وأعمارك، وموقعك، والخطط المتاحة.

segments.src: ## Choosing a metal tier
segments.tr: ## اختيار شريحة معدنية

segments.src: Marketplace plans are grouped into Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum (Platinum is less common).
segments.tr: يتم تجميع خطط السوق إلى البرونزي والفضة والذهبي والبلاتيني (البلاتيني أقل شيوعًا).

segments.src: The tiers describe how costs are split between you and the insurer on average, not the quality of care or the doctors you can see.
segments.tr: تصف الشرائح كيف يتم تقسيم التكاليف بينك وبين شركة التأمين في المتوسط، وليس جودة الرعاية أو الأطباء الذين يمكنك رؤيتهم.

segments.src: - **Bronze:** Lowest monthly premiums, highest deductibles. Often a fit for people who want protection against a major event and rarely use care. Some Bronze and Catastrophe plans may be compatible with a health savings account, depending on current rules.
segments.tr: - **البرونزي:** أقساط شهرية أدنى، أعلى الخصومات. مناسب غالبًا للأشخاص الذين يريدون حماية ضد حدث رئيسي ونادرًا ما يستخدمون الرعاية. قد تكون بعض الخطط البرونزية وخطط الكوارث متوافقة مع حساب توفير الصحة، اعتمادًا على القواعد الحالية.

segments.src: - **Silver:** Mid-range premiums. If your income is within the range for cost-sharing reductions (CSRs), Silver plans can carry much lower deductibles and out-of-pocket limits than usual. This benefit is available only on Silver plans purchased through the Marketplace.
segments.tr: - **الفضة:** أقساط متوسطة المدى. إذا كان دخلك ضمن نطاق تخفيضات تقاسم التكاليف (CSRs)، يمكن أن تحظى خطط الفضة بخصومات أقل بكثير وحدود دفع ذاتي أقل من المعتاد. هذه الميزة متاحة فقط في خطط الفضة التي يتم شراؤها من خلال السوق.

segments.src: - **Gold:** Higher premiums, lower deductibles and copays. This can make sense for households that expect frequent visits, ongoing prescriptions or a planned procedure.
segments.tr: - **الذهبي:** أقساط أعلى، خصومات ومستحقات أقل. يمكن أن يكون هذا منطقيًا للأسر التي تتوقع زيارات متكررة، أو وصفات طبية مستمرة، أو إجراءً مخططًا له.

segments.src: - **Platinum:** Highest premiums and lowest cost sharing where offered.
segments.tr: - **البلاتيني:** أعلى الأقساط وأقل تقاسم للتكاليف حيثما توفر.

segments.src: In some areas, a Gold plan can cost close to a Silver plan or even less after subsidies, because of how insurers price Silver plans.
segments.tr: في بعض المناطق، يمكن أن تكلف خطة ذهبية قريبًا من خطة فضية أو أقل حتى بعد الإعانات، بسبب كيفية تسعير شركات التأمين لخطط الفضة.

segments.src: Always compare the post-subsidy price for each tier rather than assuming Bronze is cheapest in total.
segments.tr: دائمًا ما تقارن السعر بعد الإعانة لكل شريحة بدلاً من افتراض أن البرونزي هو الأرخص إجمالاً.

segments.src: ## What to compare before the deadline
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مقارنته قبل الموعد النهائي

segments.src: Premium alone does not capture the full cost of coverage.
segments.tr: القسط وحدها لا يجسد التكلفة الكاملة للتغطية.

segments.src: Before you choose, compare:
segments.tr: قبل أن تختار، قارن:

segments.src: - **Monthly premium after the tax credit.** Use the exchange's window-shopping or plan comparison tool with your estimated income.
segments.tr: - **القسط الشهري بعد الإعفاء الضريبي.** استخدم أداة تسوق النوافذ أو مقارنة الخطط الخاصة بالتبادل مع دخلك المقدر.

segments.src: - **Deductible and out-of-pocket maximum.** The out-of-pocket limit is the most you would pay in covered, in-network care in a year.
segments.tr: - **الخصم والحد الأقصى للدفع الذاتي.** حد الدفع الذاتي هو الحد الأقصى الذي تدفعه في الرعاية المغطاة داخل الشبكة في السنة.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance** for primary care, specialists, urgent care and emergency visits.
segments.tr: - **المدفوعات المشتركة والتأمين المشترك** للرعاية الأولية، والمتخصصين، والرعاية العاجلة، وزيارات الطوارئ.

segments.src: - **Provider network.** Confirm that your doctors, hospitals and pharmacies are in-network. Check directly with the provider's office, since online directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **شبكة مقدمي الخدمات.** تأكد من أن أطباءك ومستشفياتك وصيدلياتك داخل الشبكة. تحقق مباشرة مع مكتب مقدم الخدمة، حيث يمكن أن تكون الدلائل عبر الإنترنت قديمة.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug formulary.** Look up each medication, its tier and any prior-authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **قائمة الأدوية الموصوفة.** ابحث عن كل دواء، وشريحته، وأي متطلب ترخيص مسبق.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing reductions.** If your income may qualify, compare Silver plans with CSRs against other tiers.
segments.tr: - **تخفيضات تقاسم التكاليف.** إذا كان دخلك قد يؤهلك، قارن خطط الفضة مع تخفيضات تقاسم التكاليف (CSRs) مقابل الشرائح الأخرى.

segments.src: - **Plan type.** HMOs, PPOs and EPOs differ in referral rules and out-of-network coverage.
segments.tr: - **نوع الخطة.** تختلف خطط HMOs وPPOs وEPOs في قواعد الإحالة والتغطية خارج الشبكة.

segments.src: - **Family needs.** Consider dental and vision for children, maternity care, mental health services and any expected procedures.
segments.tr: - **احتياجات العائلة.** ضع في اعتبارك رعاية الأسنان والرؤية للأطفال، ورعاية الأمومة، وخدمات الصحة العقلية، وأي إجراءات متوقعة.

segments.src: ## Getting your income estimate right
segments.tr: ## الحصول على تقدير دخلك بالشكل الصحيح

segments.src: Subsidies are calculated on projected household income for the coverage year.
segments.tr: يتم احتساب الإعانات على دخل الأسرة المتوقع لسنة التغطية.

segments.src: If you underestimate, you may have to repay part of the credit at tax time.
segments.tr: إذا ققلت التقدير، فقد تضطر إلى سداد جزء من الإعفاء في وقت الضرائب.

segments.src: If you overestimate, you may pay more per month than needed, though you can recover the difference when you file.
segments.tr: إذا بالغت في التقدير، فقد تدفع شهريًا أكثر مما تحتاج، رغم أنه يمكنك استرداد الفرق عند تقديم الضرائب.

segments.src: Gig workers, the self-employed and people with irregular hours should review their projections carefully and update their application if income changes during the year.
segments.tr: يجب على عمال العقود المؤقتة، والعاملين لحسابهم الخاص، والأشخاص الذين لديهم ساعات غير منتظمة مراجعة توقعاتهم بعناية وتحديث طلبهم إذا تغير الدخل خلال العام.

segments.src: Also confirm who counts in your tax household, since that affects eligibility and the size of any credit.
segments.tr: تأكد أيضًا من من يُعتبر في أسرتك الضريبية، لأن ذلك يؤثر على الأهلية وحجم أي إعفاء.

segments.src: ## Key dates and practical steps
segments.tr: ## التواريخ الرئيسية والخطوات العملية

segments.src: - **November 1:** Open enrollment begins for 2027 coverage. Window shopping may be available earlier on some sites.
segments.tr: - **1 نوفمبر:** يبدأ التسجيل المفتوح لتغطية عام 2027. قد يتوفر تسوق النوافذ مبكرًا على بعض المواقع.

segments.src: - **Deadlines:** Federal rules have recently changed the length of open enrollment, and some provisions have been the subject of legal challenges. Many exchanges close in mid-December for coverage that starts January 1, while some state exchanges run into January. Check your exchange's published dates, and do not assume last year's deadline still applies.
segments.tr: - **المواعيد النهائية:** غيرت القواعد الفيدرالية مؤخرًا مدة التسجيل المفتوح، وكانت بعض الأحكام موضوع طعون قانونية. تغلق العديد من التبادلات في منتصف ديسمبر للتغطية التي تبدأ في 1 يناير، بينما تستمر بعض تبادلات الولاية حتى يناير. تحقق من التواريخ المنشورة لتبادلك، ولا تفترض أن الموعد النهائي للعام الماضي لا يزال ينطبق.

segments.src: - **Existing enrollees:** Review your renewal notice even if you plan to keep your plan. Plans can change prices, networks and formularies, and automatic renewal may not choose the best option for you.
segments.tr: - **المشتركون الحاليون:** راجع إشعار التجديد الخاص بك حتى لو كنت تخطط للاحتفاظ بخطتك. يمكن للخطط تغيير الأسعار والشبكات وقوائم الأدوية، وقد لا يختار التجديد التلقائي الخيار الأفضل لك.

segments.src: - **After the deadline:** Outside open enrollment, you generally need a qualifying life event, such as losing other coverage, marriage, the birth of a child or a move, to enroll. Medicaid and the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) accept applications year-round if you qualify.
segments.tr: - **بعد الموعد النهائي:** خارج التسجيل المفتوح، تحتاج عمومًا إلى حدث حياتي مؤهل، مثل فقدان تغطية أخرى، أو الزواج، أو ولادة طفل، أو الانتقال، للتسجيل. تقبل Medicaid وبرنامج تأمين صحة الأطفال (CHIP) الطلبات طوال العام إذا كنت مؤهلاً.

segments.src: ## Where to get help
segments.tr: ## أين تحصل على المساعدة

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: تتوفر مساعدة مجانية ومدربة.

segments.src: Navigators, certified application counselors and licensed agents and brokers can help you compare plans and complete an application.
segments.tr: يمكن للملاحين، ومستشاري التطبيق المعتمدين، والوكلاء والوسطاء المرخصين مساعدتك في مقارنة الخطط وإكمال الطلب.

segments.src: Use the official exchange website, such as HealthCare.gov or your state's exchange, to find local help.
segments.tr: استخدم موقع التبادل الرسمي، مثل HealthCare.gov أو تبادل ولايتك، للعثور على مساعدة محلية.

segments.src: Be cautious of unsolicited calls, texts or ads promising free or guaranteed coverage, and never share personal or financial information with anyone you cannot verify.
segments.tr: كن حذرًا من المكالمات غير المرغوب فيها، أو الرسائل النصية، أو الإعلانات التي تعد بتغطية مجانية أو مضمونة، ولا تشارك أبدًا معلومات شخصية أو مالية مع أي شخص لا يمكنك التحقق منه.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Your 2027 cost will come down to your plan's price, your subsidy and the tier you choose.
segments.tr: ستنخفض تكلفتك لعام 2027 إلى سعر خطتك، وإعانتك، والشريحة التي تختارها.

segments.src: Start early, compare the post-subsidy price and the full cost-sharing picture for each option, verify your doctors and prescriptions, and check your exchange's exact deadline.
segments.tr: ابدأ مبكرًا، وقارن السعر بعد الإعانة وصورة تقاسم التكاليف الكاملة لكل خيار، وتحقق من أطبائك وأدويتك، وتحقق من الموعد النهائي الدقيق لتبادلك.

segments.src: A few extra minutes of comparison can make a meaningful difference in what your family pays across the year.
segments.tr: يمكن لبضع دقائق إضافية من المقارنة أن تحدث فرقًا مجديًا فيما تدفعه عائلتك طوال العام.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and does not constitute insurance, tax or legal advice.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة لأغراض معلومات عامة فقط ولا تشكل نصيحة تأمينية أو ضريبية أو قانونية.

segments.tr: الأرقام في الأمثلة توضيحية.

segments.src: Consult your exchange, a licensed professional or a tax adviser about your specific situation.*
segments.tr: استشر التبادل الخاص بك، أو محترفًا مرخصًا، أو مستشارًا ضريبيًا حول وضعك المحدد.*

fr.title: L'inscription ouverte à l'ACA pour 2027 commence le 1er novembre : comment les primes, les subventions et les niveaux de couverture (metal tiers) pourraient modifier votre facture mensuelle

segments.src: Open enrollment for 2027 Affordable Care Act (ACA) Marketplace coverage begins November 1.
segments.tr: L'inscription ouverte pour la couverture du marché de l'Affordable Care Act (ACA) de 2027 commence le 1er novembre.

segments.src: Shoppers on HealthCare.gov and in state-based exchanges will soon be able to see next year's plans and prices.
segments.tr: Les acheteurs sur HealthCare.gov et sur les bourses basées sur les États pourront bientôt voir les plans et les prix de l'année prochaine.

segments.src: For many households, the monthly premium will depend on three things: the sticker price of the plan, the amount of financial help they qualify for, and the metal tier they choose.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux ménages, la prime mensuelle dépendra de trois éléments : le prix affiché du plan, le montant de l'aide financière à laquelle ils ont droit et le niveau de couverture (metal tier) qu'ils choisissent.

segments.src: This explainer walks through each of those pieces and lists what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: Cette explication passe en revue chacun de ces éléments et liste ce qu'il faut comparer avant la date limite.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales, et non de conseils financiers ou d'assurance personnels.

segments.src: Rules, dates and prices vary by state and by household, so confirm details on your own exchange.
segments.tr: Les règles, les dates et les prix varient selon l'État et le ménage, alors confirmez les détails sur votre propre bourse.

segments.src: ## Why this enrollment season is different
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cette saison d'inscription est différente

segments.src: Starting with the 2026 plan year, the enhanced premium tax credits that Congress put in place in 2021 and later extended were scheduled to expire.
segments.tr: À partir de l'année de plan 2026, les crédits d'impôt sur les primes améliorés que le Congrès avait mis en place en 2021 et prolongés par la suite devaient expirer.

segments.src: Those enhanced credits had done two main things:
segments.tr: Ces crédits améliorés avaient deux effets principaux :

segments.src: - They lowered the share of income that many enrollees were expected to pay toward a benchmark plan.
segments.tr: - Ils ont réduit la part du revenu que de nombreux inscrits devaient payer pour un plan de référence.

segments.src: - They removed the "subsidy cliff" at 400% of the federal poverty level, so higher-income households could still qualify for help if the benchmark plan cost more than a set percentage of their income.
segments.tr: - Ils ont supprimé le « seuil de subvention » à 400 % du niveau fédéral de pauvreté, de sorte que les ménages à revenu plus élevé pouvaient toujours bénéficier d'une aide si le plan de référence coûtait plus cher qu'un pourcentage défini de leur revenu.

segments.src: When the enhanced credits lapse, the original ACA subsidy structure applies.
segments.tr: Lorsque les crédits améliorés expirent, la structure de subvention originale de l'ACA s'applique.

segments.src: Under that structure, the expected contribution rises for most enrollees, and households above 400% of the poverty level generally receive no premium tax credit at all.
segments.tr: Dans le cadre de cette structure, la contribution attendue augmente pour la plupart des inscrits, et les ménages au-dessus de 400 % du niveau de pauvreté ne reçoivent généralement aucun crédit d'impôt sur les primes.

segments.src: Whether lawmakers change these rules again is a policy question that can shift quickly, so check the current federal guidance and your exchange's notices rather than relying on last year's numbers.
segments.tr: La question de savoir si les législateurs modifieront à nouveau ces règles est une question politique qui peut changer rapidement, alors vérifiez les directives fédérales actuelles et les avis de votre bourse plutôt que de vous fier aux chiffres de l'année dernière.

segments.src: ## How 2027 premiums are set
segments.tr: ## Comment les primes de 2027 sont fixées

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates with state regulators, who review them before final prices are published.
segments.tr: Les assureurs déposent des propositions de tarifs auprès des régulateurs des États, qui les examinent avant que les prix finaux ne soient publiés.

segments.src: Several factors typically push rates up or down:
segments.tr: Plusieurs facteurs font généralement monter ou descendre les tarifs :

segments.src: - **Medical costs and utilization.** Hospital prices, prescription drug spending and how often people use care all feed into rate requests.
segments.tr: - **Coûts médicaux et utilisation.** Les prix des hôpitaux, les dépenses en médicaments sur ordonnance et la fréquence à laquelle les gens utilisent les soins alimentent tous les demandes de tarifs.

segments.src: - **Who enrolls.** If healthier people leave the market because subsidies shrink, the remaining pool can be costlier on average, which insurers may reflect in prices.
segments.tr: - **Qui s'inscrit.** Si les personnes en meilleure santé quittent le marché parce que les subventions diminuent, le groupe restant peut être plus coûteux en moyenne, ce que les assureurs peuvent refléter dans les prix.

segments.src: - **Regulatory changes.** Federal and state rules on eligibility, verification and enrollment periods can affect how many people sign up.
segments.tr: - **Changements réglementaires.** Les règles fédérales et étatiques sur l'admissibilité, la vérification et les périodes d'inscription peuvent affecter le nombre de personnes qui s'inscrivent.

segments.src: - **Local competition.** Counties with several insurers often see more stable prices than counties with only one or two.
segments.tr: - **Concurrence locale.** Les comtés avec plusieurs assureurs voient souvent des prix plus stables que les comtés avec seulement un ou deux assureurs.

segments.src: Because these factors are local, the change you see can differ a lot from a neighbor's in another county or state.
segments.tr: Parce que ces facteurs sont locaux, le changement que vous voyez peut différer considérablement de celui d'un voisin dans un autre comté ou État.

segments.src: The average increase reported in the news may not match your own.
segments.tr: L'augmentation moyenne rapportée dans les nouvelles peut ne pas correspondre à la vôtre.

segments.src: ## Sticker price versus what you actually pay
segments.tr: ## Prix affiché par rapport à ce que vous payez réellement

segments.src: The price listed for a plan is not always what a household pays.
segments.tr: Le prix indiqué pour un plan n'est pas toujours ce qu'un ménage paie.

segments.src: If you qualify for a premium tax credit, the credit is based on the cost of the second-lowest-cost Silver plan in your area, known as the benchmark plan, and on your income.
segments.tr: Si vous êtes admissible à un crédit d'impôt sur les primes, le crédit est basé sur le coût du deuxième plan Argent le moins cher dans votre région, connu sous le nom de plan de référence, et sur votre revenu.

segments.src: In simple terms:
segments.tr: En termes simples :

segments.src: 1. The government estimates how much you should contribute toward the benchmark plan, as a percentage of your household income.
segments.tr: 1. Le gouvernement estime combien vous devriez contribuer au plan de référence, en pourcentage de votre revenu familial.

segments.src: 2. The tax credit covers the rest of the benchmark's cost.
segments.tr: 2. Le crédit d'impôt couvre le reste du coût du plan de référence.

segments.src: 3. You can apply that credit to any Marketplace plan, though you pay the difference if you choose a plan priced above the benchmark.
segments.tr: 3. Vous pouvez appliquer ce crédit à n'importe quel plan du marché, bien que vous payiez la différence si vous choisissez un plan dont le prix est supérieur à celui du plan de référence.

segments.src: This means that when the benchmark premium rises, a subsidized household may see little change in its own payment, while an unsubsidized household bears the full increase.
segments.tr: Cela signifie que lorsque la prime de référence augmente, un ménage subventionné peut ne voir que peu de changement dans son propre paiement, tandis qu'un ménage non subventionné supporte la totalité de l'augmentation.

segments.src: It also means that a change in the subsidy formula can change your bill even if your plan's price stays flat.
segments.tr: Cela signifie également qu'un changement dans la formule de subvention peut modifier votre facture même si le prix de votre plan reste stable.

segments.src: ### A simple illustration
segments.tr: ### Une illustration simple

segments.src: The numbers below are made up to show the mechanics.
segments.tr: Les chiffres ci-dessous sont inventés pour montrer les mécanismes.

segments.src: They are not forecasts.
segments.tr: Ce ne sont pas des prévisions.

segments.src: | | Scenario A | Scenario B |
segments.tr: | | Scénario A | Scénario B |

segments.tr: | Prix du plan de référence (mensuel) | $1,200 | $1,300 |

segments.tr: | Contribution attendue du ménage | $400 | $450 |

segments.src: Even with a larger credit, the family pays $50 more per month.
segments.tr: Même avec un crédit plus important, la famille paie 50 $ de plus par mois.

segments.src: Your own result depends on your income, ages, location and the plans available.
segments.tr: Votre propre résultat dépend de votre revenu, de vos âges, de votre emplacement et des plans disponibles.

segments.src: ## Choosing a metal tier
segments.tr: ## Choisir un niveau de couverture (metal tier)

segments.src: Marketplace plans are grouped into Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum (Platinum is less common).
segments.tr: Les plans du marché sont regroupés en Bronze, Argent, Or et Platine (le Platine est moins courant).

segments.src: The tiers describe how costs are split between you and the insurer on average, not the quality of care or the doctors you can see.
segments.tr: Les niveaux décrivent comment les coûts sont répartis entre vous et l'assureur en moyenne, et non la qualité des soins ou les médecins que vous pouvez consulter.

segments.src: - **Bronze:** Lowest monthly premiums, highest deductibles. Often a fit for people who want protection against a major event and rarely use care. Some Bronze and Catastrophe plans may be compatible with a health savings account, depending on current rules.
segments.tr: - **Bronze :** Primes mensuelles les plus basses, franchises les plus élevées. Souvent adapté aux personnes qui veulent une protection contre un événement majeur et qui utilisent rarement les soins. Certains plans Bronze et Catastrophe peuvent être compatibles avec un compte d'épargne santé, selon les règles actuelles.

segments.src: - **Silver:** Mid-range premiums. If your income is within the range for cost-sharing reductions (CSRs), Silver plans can carry much lower deductibles and out-of-pocket limits than usual. This benefit is available only on Silver plans purchased through the Marketplace.
segments.tr: - **Argent :** Primes de milieu de gamme. Si votre revenu se situe dans la fourchette des réductions de partage des coûts (CSR), les plans Argent peuvent entraîner des franchises et des limites de dépenses personnelles beaucoup plus faibles que d'habitude. Cet avantage n'est disponible que sur les plans Argent achetés via le marché.

segments.src: - **Gold:** Higher premiums, lower deductibles and copays. This can make sense for households that expect frequent visits, ongoing prescriptions or a planned procedure.
segments.tr: - **Or :** Primes plus élevées, franchises et quotes-parts plus faibles. Cela peut être logique pour les ménages qui prévoient des visites fréquentes, des ordonnances continues ou une intervention planifiée.

segments.src: - **Platinum:** Highest premiums and lowest cost sharing where offered.
segments.tr: - **Platine :** Primes les plus élevées et partage des coûts le plus bas là où il est proposé.

segments.src: In some areas, a Gold plan can cost close to a Silver plan or even less after subsidies, because of how insurers price Silver plans.
segments.tr: Dans certaines régions, un plan Or peut coûter près d'un plan Argent ou même moins après subventions, en raison de la façon dont les assureurs fixent le prix des plans Argent.

segments.src: Always compare the post-subsidy price for each tier rather than assuming Bronze is cheapest in total.
segments.tr: Comparez toujours le prix après subvention pour chaque niveau plutôt que de supposer que le Bronze est le moins cher au total.

segments.src: ## What to compare before the deadline
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut comparer avant la date limite

segments.src: Premium alone does not capture the full cost of coverage.
segments.tr: La prime seule ne capture pas le coût total de la couverture.

segments.src: Before you choose, compare:
segments.tr: Avant de choisir, comparez :

segments.src: - **Monthly premium after the tax credit.** Use the exchange's window-shopping or plan comparison tool with your estimated income.
segments.tr: - **Prime mensuelle après le crédit d'impôt.** Utilisez l'outil de comparaison de plans ou de lèche-vitrine de la bourse avec votre revenu estimé.

segments.src: - **Deductible and out-of-pocket maximum.** The out-of-pocket limit is the most you would pay in covered, in-network care in a year.
segments.tr: - **Franchise et maximum des dépenses personnelles.** La limite des dépenses personnelles est le montant maximum que vous paieriez pour des soins couverts et en réseau en un an.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance** for primary care, specialists, urgent care and emergency visits.
segments.tr: - **Quotes-parts et coassurance** pour les soins primaires, les spécialistes, les soins urgents et les visites d'urgence.

segments.src: - **Provider network.** Confirm that your doctors, hospitals and pharmacies are in-network. Check directly with the provider's office, since online directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **Réseau de prestataires.** Confirmez que vos médecins, hôpitaux et pharmacies sont en réseau. Vérifiez directement auprès du cabinet du prestataire, car les répertoires en ligne peuvent être obsolètes.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug formulary.** Look up each medication, its tier and any prior-authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **Formulaire de médicaments sur ordonnance.** Recherchez chaque médicament, son niveau et toute exigence d'autorisation préalable.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing reductions.** If your income may qualify, compare Silver plans with CSRs against other tiers.
segments.tr: - **Réductions de partage des coûts.** Si votre revenu peut vous y rendre admissible, comparez les plans Argent avec CSR par rapport aux autres niveaux.

segments.src: - **Plan type.** HMOs, PPOs and EPOs differ in referral rules and out-of-network coverage.
segments.tr: - **Type de plan.** Les HMO, PPO et EPO diffèrent dans les règles de référence et la couverture hors réseau.

segments.src: - **Family needs.** Consider dental and vision for children, maternity care, mental health services and any expected procedures.
segments.tr: - **Besoins familiaux.** Tenez compte des soins dentaires et de la vision pour les enfants, des soins de maternité, des services de santé mentale et de toute intervention prévue.

segments.src: ## Getting your income estimate right
segments.tr: ## Obtenir une estimation correcte de votre revenu

segments.src: Subsidies are calculated on projected household income for the coverage year.
segments.tr: Les subventions sont calculées sur le revenu familial projeté pour l'année de couverture.

segments.src: If you underestimate, you may have to repay part of the credit at tax time.
segments.tr: Si vous sous-estimez, vous devrez peut-être rembourser une partie du crédit au moment de la déclaration d'impôts.

segments.src: If you overestimate, you may pay more per month than needed, though you can recover the difference when you file.
segments.tr: Si vous surestimez, vous pourriez payer plus par mois que nécessaire, bien que vous puissiez récupérer la différence lors de votre déclaration.

segments.src: Gig workers, the self-employed and people with irregular hours should review their projections carefully and update their application if income changes during the year.
segments.tr: Les travailleurs à la tâche, les travailleurs indépendants et les personnes ayant des horaires irréguliers devraient examiner attentivement leurs projections et mettre à jour leur demande si le revenu change au cours de l'année.

segments.src: Also confirm who counts in your tax household, since that affects eligibility and the size of any credit.
segments.tr: Confirmez également qui compte dans votre ménage fiscal, car cela affecte l'admissibilité et la taille de tout crédit.

segments.src: ## Key dates and practical steps
segments.tr: ## Dates clés et étapes pratiques

segments.src: - **November 1:** Open enrollment begins for 2027 coverage. Window shopping may be available earlier on some sites.
segments.tr: - **1er novembre :** L'inscription ouverte commence pour la couverture 2027. Le lèche-vitrine peut être disponible plus tôt sur certains sites.

segments.src: - **Deadlines:** Federal rules have recently changed the length of open enrollment, and some provisions have been the subject of legal challenges. Many exchanges close in mid-December for coverage that starts January 1, while some state exchanges run into January. Check your exchange's published dates, and do not assume last year's deadline still applies.
segments.tr: - **Dates limites :** Les règles fédérales ont récemment modifié la durée de l'inscription ouverte, et certaines dispositions ont fait l'objet de contestations judiciaires. De nombreuses bourses ferment à la mi-décembre pour une couverture commençant le 1er janvier, tandis que certaines bourses étatiques fonctionnent jusqu'en janvier. Vérifiez les dates publiées par votre bourse et ne supposez pas que la date limite de l'année dernière s'applique toujours.

segments.src: - **Existing enrollees:** Review your renewal notice even if you plan to keep your plan. Plans can change prices, networks and formularies, and automatic renewal may not choose the best option for you.
segments.tr: - **Inscrits existants :** Examinez votre avis de renouvellement même si vous prévoyez de conserver votre plan. Les plans peuvent changer de prix, de réseaux et de formulaires, et le renouvellement automatique peut ne pas choisir la meilleure option pour vous.

segments.src: - **After the deadline:** Outside open enrollment, you generally need a qualifying life event, such as losing other coverage, marriage, the birth of a child or a move, to enroll. Medicaid and the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) accept applications year-round if you qualify.
segments.tr: - **Après la date limite :** En dehors de l'inscription ouverte, vous avez généralement besoin d'un événement de vie qualifiant, tel que la perte d'une autre couverture, le mariage, la naissance d'un enfant ou un déménagement, pour vous inscrire. Medicaid et le Programme d'assurance maladie pour enfants (CHIP) acceptent les demandes toute l'année si vous êtes admissible.

segments.src: ## Where to get help
segments.tr: ## Où obtenir de l'aide

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: Une assistance gratuite et formée est disponible.

segments.src: Navigators, certified application counselors and licensed agents and brokers can help you compare plans and complete an application.
segments.tr: Les navigateurs, les conseillers en demande certifiés et les agents et courtiers agréés peuvent vous aider à comparer les plans et à remplir une demande.

segments.src: Use the official exchange website, such as HealthCare.gov or your state's exchange, to find local help.
segments.tr: Utilisez le site Web officiel de la bourse, tel que HealthCare.gov ou la bourse de votre État, pour trouver de l'aide locale.

segments.src: Be cautious of unsolicited calls, texts or ads promising free or guaranteed coverage, and never share personal or financial information with anyone you cannot verify.
segments.tr: Soyez prudent face aux appels, SMS ou publicités non sollicités promettant une couverture gratuite ou garantie, et ne partagez jamais d'informations personnelles ou financières avec quelqu'un que vous ne pouvez pas vérifier.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: Your 2027 cost will come down to your plan's price, your subsidy and the tier you choose.
segments.tr: Votre coût pour 2027 dépendra du prix de votre plan, de votre subvention et du niveau que vous choisissez.

segments.src: Start early, compare the post-subsidy price and the full cost-sharing picture for each option, verify your doctors and prescriptions, and check your exchange's exact deadline.
segments.tr: Commencez tôt, comparez le prix après subvention et l'image complète du partage des coûts pour chaque option, vérifiez vos médecins et vos ordonnances, et vérifiez la date limite exacte de votre bourse.

segments.src: A few extra minutes of comparison can make a meaningful difference in what your family pays across the year.
segments.tr: Quelques minutes supplémentaires de comparaison peuvent faire une différence significative dans ce que votre famille paie tout au long de l'année.

pt.title: A Inscrição Aberta do ACA para 2027 Começa em 1º de Novembro: Como Prêmios, Subsídios e Níveis de Metais Podem Alterar Sua Conta Mensal

segments.src: Open enrollment for 2027 Affordable Care Act (ACA) Marketplace coverage begins November 1.
segments.tr: A inscrição aberta para a cobertura do Mercado da Lei de Cuidados Acessíveis (ACA) de 2027 começa em 1º de novembro.

segments.src: Shoppers on HealthCare.gov and in state-based exchanges will soon be able to see next year's plans and prices.
segments.tr: Os compradores no HealthCare.gov e nas trocas baseadas no estado em breve poderão ver os planos e preços do próximo ano.

segments.src: For many households, the monthly premium will depend on three things: the sticker price of the plan, the amount of financial help they qualify for, and the metal tier they choose.
segments.tr: Para muitas famílias, o prêmio mensal dependerá de três coisas: o preço de tabela do plano, o valor da ajuda financeira a que têm direito e o nível de metal que escolhem.

segments.src: This explainer walks through each of those pieces and lists what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: Este explicador percorre cada uma dessas peças e lista o que comparar antes do prazo.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: É uma informação geral, não um conselho financeiro ou de seguro pessoal.

segments.src: Rules, dates and prices vary by state and by household, so confirm details on your own exchange.
segments.tr: Regras, datas e preços variam por estado e por domicílio, portanto, confirme os detalhes em sua própria bolsa.

segments.src: ## Why this enrollment season is different
segments.tr: ## Por que esta temporada de inscrições é diferente

segments.src: Starting with the 2026 plan year, the enhanced premium tax credits that Congress put in place in 2021 and later extended were scheduled to expire.
segments.tr: A partir do ano de plano de 2026, os créditos fiscais de prêmio aprimorados que o Congresso estabeleceu em 2021 e posteriormente prorrogados deveriam expirar.

segments.src: Those enhanced credits had done two main things:
segments.tr: Esses créditos aprimorados fizeram duas coisas principais:

segments.src: - They lowered the share of income that many enrollees were expected to pay toward a benchmark plan.
segments.tr: - Eles reduziram a parcela da renda que muitos inscritos deveriam pagar em direção a um plano de referência.

segments.src: - They removed the "subsidy cliff" at 400% of the federal poverty level, so higher-income households could still qualify for help if the benchmark plan cost more than a set percentage of their income.
segments.tr: - Eles removeram o "penhasco de subsídio" a 400% do nível federal de pobreza, para que famílias de renda mais alta ainda pudessem se qualificar para ajuda se o plano de referência custasse mais do que uma porcentagem definida de sua renda.

segments.src: When the enhanced credits lapse, the original ACA subsidy structure applies.
segments.tr: Quando os créditos aprimorados caducam, a estrutura de subsídio original da ACA se aplica.

segments.src: Under that structure, the expected contribution rises for most enrollees, and households above 400% of the poverty level generally receive no premium tax credit at all.
segments.tr: Sob essa estrutura, a contribuição esperada aumenta para a maioria dos inscritos, e as famílias acima de 400% do nível de pobreza geralmente não recebem nenhum crédito fiscal de prêmio.

segments.src: Whether lawmakers change these rules again is a policy question that can shift quickly, so check the current federal guidance and your exchange's notices rather than relying on last year's numbers.
segments.tr: Se os legisladores mudarem essas regras novamente é uma questão de política que pode mudar rapidamente, portanto, verifique a orientação federal atual e os avisos de sua bolsa em vez de confiar nos números do ano passado.

segments.src: ## How 2027 premiums are set
segments.tr: ## Como os prêmios de 2027 são definidos

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates with state regulators, who review them before final prices are published.
segments.tr: As seguradoras arquivam taxas propostas com reguladores estaduais, que os revisam antes que os preços finais sejam publicados.

segments.src: Several factors typically push rates up or down:
segments.tr: Vários fatores normalmente empurram as taxas para cima ou para baixo:

segments.src: - **Medical costs and utilization.** Hospital prices, prescription drug spending and how often people use care all feed into rate requests.
segments.tr: - **Custos médicos e utilização.** Preços de hospitais, gastos com medicamentos prescritos e com que freqüência as pessoas usam cuidados alimentam os pedidos de taxas.

segments.src: - **Who enrolls.** If healthier people leave the market because subsidies shrink, the remaining pool can be costlier on average, which insurers may reflect in prices.
segments.tr: - **Quem se inscreve.** Se as pessoas mais saudáveis saírem do mercado porque os subsídios encolhem, o pool restante pode ser mais custoso em média, o que as seguradoras podem refletir nos preços.

segments.src: - **Regulatory changes.** Federal and state rules on eligibility, verification and enrollment periods can affect how many people sign up.
segments.tr: - **Mudanças regulatórias.** Regras federais e estaduais sobre elegibilidade, verificação e períodos de inscrição podem afetar quantas pessoas se inscrevem.

segments.src: - **Local competition.** Counties with several insurers often see more stable prices than counties with only one or two.
segments.tr: - **Concorrência local.** Os condados com várias seguradoras geralmente veem preços mais estáveis do que os condados com apenas um ou dois.

segments.src: Because these factors are local, the change you see can differ a lot from a neighbor's in another county or state.
segments.tr: Como esses fatores são locais, a mudança que você vê pode diferir muito da de um vizinho em outro condado ou estado.

segments.src: The average increase reported in the news may not match your own.
segments.tr: O aumento médio relatado nas notícias pode não corresponder ao seu próprio.

segments.src: ## Sticker price versus what you actually pay
segments.tr: ## Preço de tabela versus o que você realmente paga

segments.src: The price listed for a plan is not always what a household pays.
segments.tr: O preço listado para um plano nem sempre é o que uma família paga.

segments.src: If you qualify for a premium tax credit, the credit is based on the cost of the second-lowest-cost Silver plan in your area, known as the benchmark plan, and on your income.
segments.tr: Se você se qualificar para um crédito fiscal de prêmio, o crédito é baseado no custo do segundo plano Silver de menor custo em sua área, conhecido como plano de referência, e na sua renda.

segments.src: In simple terms:
segments.tr: Em termos simples:

segments.src: 1. The government estimates how much you should contribute toward the benchmark plan, as a percentage of your household income.
segments.tr: 1. O governo estima quanto você deve contribuir para o plano de referência, como uma porcentagem da sua renda familiar.

segments.src: 2. The tax credit covers the rest of the benchmark's cost.
segments.tr: 2. O crédito fiscal cobre o restante do custo da referência.

segments.src: 3. You can apply that credit to any Marketplace plan, though you pay the difference if you choose a plan priced above the benchmark.
segments.tr: 3. Você pode aplicar esse crédito a qualquer plano do Mercado, embora pague a diferença se escolher um plano com preço acima da referência.

segments.src: This means that when the benchmark premium rises, a subsidized household may see little change in its own payment, while an unsubsidized household bears the full increase.
segments.tr: Isso significa que, quando o prêmio de referência sobe, uma família subsidiada pode ver pouca mudança em seu próprio pagamento, enquanto uma família não subsidiada arca com o aumento total.

segments.src: It also means that a change in the subsidy formula can change your bill even if your plan's price stays flat.
segments.tr: Isso também significa que uma mudança na fórmula do subsídio pode alterar sua conta mesmo que o preço do seu plano permaneça estável.

segments.tr: ### Uma ilustração simples

segments.src: The numbers below are made up to show the mechanics.
segments.tr: Os números abaixo são inventados para mostrar a mecânica.

segments.src: They are not forecasts.
segments.tr: Eles não são previsões.

segments.tr: | | Cenário A | Cenário B |

segments.tr: | Preço do plano de referência (mensal) | $1.200 | $1.300 |

segments.tr: | Contribuição familiar esperada | $400 | $450 |

segments.src: Even with a larger credit, the family pays $50 more per month.
segments.tr: Mesmo com um crédito maior, a família paga $50 a mais por mês.

segments.src: Your own result depends on your income, ages, location and the plans available.
segments.tr: Seu próprio resultado depende de sua renda, idades, localização e dos planos disponíveis.

segments.src: ## Choosing a metal tier
segments.tr: ## Escolhendo um nível de metal

segments.src: Marketplace plans are grouped into Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum (Platinum is less common).
segments.tr: Os planos do Mercado são agrupados em Bronze, Prata, Ouro e Platina (Platina é menos comum).

segments.src: The tiers describe how costs are split between you and the insurer on average, not the quality of care or the doctors you can see.
segments.tr: Os níveis descrevem como os custos são divididos entre você e a seguradora em média, não a qualidade do atendimento ou os médicos que você pode consultar.

segments.src: - **Bronze:** Lowest monthly premiums, highest deductibles. Often a fit for people who want protection against a major event and rarely use care. Some Bronze and Catastrophe plans may be compatible with a health savings account, depending on current rules.
segments.tr: - **Bronze:** Prêmios mensais mais baixos, franquias mais altas. Muitas vezes adequado para pessoas que desejam proteção contra um evento importante e raramente usam cuidados. Alguns planos Bronze e Catastróficos podem ser compatíveis com uma conta poupança de saúde, dependendo das regras atuais.

segments.src: - **Silver:** Mid-range premiums. If your income is within the range for cost-sharing reductions (CSRs), Silver plans can carry much lower deductibles and out-of-pocket limits than usual. This benefit is available only on Silver plans purchased through the Marketplace.
segments.tr: - **Silver:** Prêmios de médio porte. Se a sua renda estiver dentro da faixa de reduções de compartilhamento de custos (CSRs), os planos Silver podem ter franquias e limites de despesas diretas muito menores do que o habitual. Este benefício está disponível apenas em planos Silver comprados através do Mercado.

segments.src: - **Gold:** Higher premiums, lower deductibles and copays. This can make sense for households that expect frequent visits, ongoing prescriptions or a planned procedure.
segments.tr: - **Gold:** Prêmios mais altos, franquias e copagamentos mais baixos. Isso pode fazer sentido para famílias que esperam visitas frequentes, receitas contínuas ou um procedimento planejado.

segments.src: - **Platinum:** Highest premiums and lowest cost sharing where offered.
segments.tr: - **Platinum:** Prêmios mais altos e menor compartilhamento de custos onde oferecido.

segments.src: In some areas, a Gold plan can cost close to a Silver plan or even less after subsidies, because of how insurers price Silver plans.
segments.tr: Em algumas áreas, um plano Gold pode custar perto de um plano Silver ou até menos após os subsídios, devido a como as seguradoras precificam os planos Silver.

segments.src: Always compare the post-subsidy price for each tier rather than assuming Bronze is cheapest in total.
segments.tr: Sempre compare o preço pós-subsídio para cada nível em vez de assumir que o Bronze é o mais barato no total.

segments.src: ## What to compare before the deadline
segments.tr: ## O que comparar antes do prazo

segments.src: Premium alone does not capture the full cost of coverage.
segments.tr: O prêmio sozinho não captura o custo total da cobertura.

segments.src: Before you choose, compare:
segments.tr: Antes de escolher, compare:

segments.src: - **Monthly premium after the tax credit.** Use the exchange's window-shopping or plan comparison tool with your estimated income.
segments.tr: - **Prêmio mensal após o crédito fiscal.** Use a ferramenta de comparação de janelas ou planos da bolsa com sua renda estimada.

segments.src: - **Deductible and out-of-pocket maximum.** The out-of-pocket limit is the most you would pay in covered, in-network care in a year.
segments.tr: - **Franquia e máximo do bolso.** O limite do bolso é o máximo que você pagaria em cuidados cobertos e na rede em um ano.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance** for primary care, specialists, urgent care and emergency visits.
segments.tr: - **Copagamentos e co-seguro** para cuidados primários, especialistas, cuidados urgentes e visitas de emergência.

segments.src: - **Provider network.** Confirm that your doctors, hospitals and pharmacies are in-network. Check directly with the provider's office, since online directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **Rede de provedores.** Confirme se seus médicos, hospitais e farmácias estão na rede. Verifique diretamente com o consultório do provedor, pois os diretórios online podem estar desatualizados.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug formulary.** Look up each medication, its tier and any prior-authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **Formulário de medicamentos prescritos.** Procure cada medicação, seu nível e qualquer requisito de autorização prévia.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing reductions.** If your income may qualify, compare Silver plans with CSRs against other tiers.
segments.tr: - **Reduções de compartilhamento de custos.** Se sua renda puder se qualificar, compare os planos Silver com os CSRs com outros níveis.

segments.src: - **Plan type.** HMOs, PPOs and EPOs differ in referral rules and out-of-network coverage.
segments.tr: - **Tipo de plano.** HMOs, PPOs e EPOs diferem nas regras de encaminhamento e na cobertura fora da rede.

segments.src: - **Family needs.** Consider dental and vision for children, maternity care, mental health services and any expected procedures.
segments.tr: - **Necessidades da família.** Considere odontologia e visão para crianças, cuidados de maternidade, serviços de saúde mental e quaisquer procedimentos esperados.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: Your 2027 cost will come down to your plan's price, your subsidy and the tier you choose.
segments.tr: Seu custo para 2027 se resumirá ao preço do seu plano, seu subsídio e o nível que você escolher.

segments.src: Start early, compare the post-subsidy price and the full cost-sharing picture for each option, verify your doctors and prescriptions, and check your exchange's exact deadline.

in.title: Pendaftaran Terbuka ACA untuk 2027 Dimulai 1 November: Bagaimana Premi, Subsidi, dan Tingkat Logam Dapat Mengubah Tagihan Bulanan Anda

segments.src: Open enrollment for 2027 Affordable Care Act (ACA) Marketplace coverage begins November 1.
segments.tr: Pendaftaran terbuka untuk cakupan Marketplace Affordable Care Act (ACA) 2027 dimulai pada 1 November.

segments.src: Shoppers on HealthCare.gov and in state-based exchanges will soon be able to see next year's plans and prices.
segments.tr: Pembeli di HealthCare.gov dan bursa tingkat negara bagian akan segera dapat melihat rencana dan harga tahun depan.

segments.src: For many households, the monthly premium will depend on three things: the sticker price of the plan, the amount of financial help they qualify for, and the metal tier they choose.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak rumah tangga, premi bulanan akan bergantung pada tiga hal: harga stiker rencana, jumlah bantuan keuangan yang memenuhi syarat untuk mereka, dan tingkat logam yang mereka pilih.

segments.src: This explainer walks through each of those pieces and lists what to compare before the deadline.
segments.tr: Penjelas ini menguraikan masing-masing bagian tersebut dan mencantumkan apa saja yang perlu dibandingkan sebelum tenggat waktu.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or insurance advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan atau asuransi pribadi.

segments.src: Rules, dates and prices vary by state and by household, so confirm details on your own exchange.
segments.tr: Aturan, tanggal, dan harga bervariasi menurut negara bagian dan rumah tangga, jadi konfirmasikan detailnya di bursa Anda sendiri.

segments.src: ## Why this enrollment season is different
segments.tr: ## Mengapa musim pendaftaran ini berbeda

segments.src: Starting with the 2026 plan year, the enhanced premium tax credits that Congress put in place in 2021 and later extended were scheduled to expire.
segments.tr: Dimulai dengan tahun rencana 2026, kredit pajak premi yang ditingkatkan yang diberlakukan Kongres pada tahun 2021 dan kemudian diperpanjang dijadwalkan akan kedaluwarsa.

segments.src: Those enhanced credits had done two main things:
segments.tr: Kredit yang ditingkatkan tersebut telah melakukan dua hal utama:

segments.src: - They lowered the share of income that many enrollees were expected to pay toward a benchmark plan.
segments.tr: - Mereka menurunkan porsi pendapatan yang diharapkan dibayar oleh banyak peserta untuk rencana tolok ukur.

segments.src: - They removed the "subsidy cliff" at 400% of the federal poverty level, so higher-income households could still qualify for help if the benchmark plan cost more than a set percentage of their income.
segments.tr: - Mereka menghapus "jurang subsidi" pada 400% dari tingkat kemiskinan federal, sehingga rumah tangga berpenghasilan lebih tinggi masih dapat memenuhi syarat untuk mendapatkan bantuan jika rencana tolok ukur berharga lebih dari persentase yang ditentukan dari pendapatan mereka.

segments.src: When the enhanced credits lapse, the original ACA subsidy structure applies.
segments.tr: Ketika kredit yang ditingkatkan kedaluwarsa, struktur subsidi ACA asli berlaku.

segments.src: Under that structure, the expected contribution rises for most enrollees, and households above 400% of the poverty level generally receive no premium tax credit at all.
segments.tr: Di bawah struktur tersebut, kontribusi yang diharapkan meningkat untuk sebagian besar peserta, dan rumah tangga di atas 400% dari tingkat kemiskinan umumnya sama sekali tidak menerima kredit pajak premi.

segments.src: Whether lawmakers change these rules again is a policy question that can shift quickly, so check the current federal guidance and your exchange's notices rather than relying on last year's numbers.
segments.tr: Apakah pembuat undang-undang mengubah aturan ini lagi adalah pertanyaan kebijakan yang dapat berubah dengan cepat, jadi periksa panduan federal saat ini dan pemberitahuan bursa Anda daripada mengandalkan angka tahun lalu.

segments.src: ## How 2027 premiums are set
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana premi 2027 ditetapkan

segments.src: Insurers file proposed rates with state regulators, who review them before final prices are published.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi mengajukan usulan tarif kepada regulator negara bagian, yang meninjaunya sebelum harga akhir dipublikasikan.

segments.src: Several factors typically push rates up or down:
segments.tr: Beberapa faktor biasanya mendorong tarif naik atau turun:

segments.src: - **Medical costs and utilization.** Hospital prices, prescription drug spending and how often people use care all feed into rate requests.
segments.tr: - **Biaya medis dan pemanfaatan.** Harga rumah sakit, pengeluaran obat resep, dan seberapa sering orang menggunakan perawatan semuanya masuk ke dalam permintaan tarif.

segments.src: - **Who enrolls.** If healthier people leave the market because subsidies shrink, the remaining pool can be costlier on average, which insurers may reflect in prices.
segments.tr: - **Siapa yang mendaftar.** Jika orang yang lebih sehat meninggalkan pasar karena subsidi menyusut, kelompok yang tersisa bisa menjadi lebih mahal rata-rata, yang mungkin dicerminkan oleh perusahaan asuransi dalam harga.

segments.src: - **Regulatory changes.** Federal and state rules on eligibility, verification and enrollment periods can affect how many people sign up.
segments.tr: - **Perubahan peraturan.** Aturan federal dan negara bagian tentang kelayakan, verifikasi, dan periode pendaftaran dapat memengaruhi berapa banyak orang yang mendaftar.

segments.src: - **Local competition.** Counties with several insurers often see more stable prices than counties with only one or two.
segments.tr: - **Persaingan lokal.** Kabupaten dengan beberapa perusahaan asuransi seringkali melihat harga yang lebih stabil daripada kabupaten dengan hanya satu atau dua.

segments.src: Because these factors are local, the change you see can differ a lot from a neighbor's in another county or state.
segments.tr: Karena faktor-faktor ini bersifat lokal, perubahan yang Anda lihat bisa sangat berbeda dari tetangga di kabupaten atau negara bagian lain.

segments.src: The average increase reported in the news may not match your own.
segments.tr: Peningkatan rata-rata yang dilaporkan dalam berita mungkin tidak cocok dengan Anda sendiri.

segments.src: ## Sticker price versus what you actually pay
segments.tr: ## Harga stiker versus apa yang sebenarnya Anda bayar

segments.src: The price listed for a plan is not always what a household pays.
segments.tr: Harga yang terdaftar untuk sebuah rencana tidak selalu yang dibayar oleh rumah tangga.

segments.src: If you qualify for a premium tax credit, the credit is based on the cost of the second-lowest-cost Silver plan in your area, known as the benchmark plan, and on your income.
segments.tr: Jika Anda memenuhi syarat untuk kredit pajak premi, kredit didasarkan pada biaya rencana Perak dengan biaya terendah kedua di daerah Anda, yang dikenal sebagai rencana tolok ukur, dan pada pendapatan Anda.

segments.src: In simple terms:
segments.tr: Secara sederhana:

segments.src: 1. The government estimates how much you should contribute toward the benchmark plan, as a percentage of your household income.
segments.tr: 1. Pemerintah memperkirakan berapa banyak yang harus Anda kontribusikan terhadap rencana tolok ukur, sebagai persentase dari pendapatan rumah tangga Anda.

segments.src: 2. The tax credit covers the rest of the benchmark's cost.
segments.tr: 2. Kredit pajak mencakup sisa biaya tolok ukur.

segments.src: 3. You can apply that credit to any Marketplace plan, though you pay the difference if you choose a plan priced above the benchmark.
segments.tr: 3. Anda dapat menerapkan kredit tersebut ke rencana Marketplace apa pun, meskipun Anda membayar selisihnya jika Anda memilih rencana dengan harga di atas tolok ukur.

segments.src: This means that when the benchmark premium rises, a subsidized household may see little change in its own payment, while an unsubsidized household bears the full increase.
segments.tr: Ini berarti bahwa ketika premi tolok ukur naik, rumah tangga bersubsidi mungkin melihat sedikit perubahan dalam pembayaran mereka sendiri, sementara rumah tangga yang tidak disubsidi menanggung kenaikan penuh.

segments.src: It also means that a change in the subsidy formula can change your bill even if your plan's price stays flat.
segments.tr: Ini juga berarti bahwa perubahan dalam formula subsidi dapat mengubah tagihan Anda bahkan jika harga rencana Anda tetap datar.

segments.src: ### A simple illustration
segments.tr: ### Ilustrasi sederhana

segments.src: The numbers below are made up to show the mechanics.
segments.tr: Angka di bawah ini dibuat untuk menunjukkan mekanika.

segments.src: They are not forecasts.
segments.tr: Mereka bukan prakiraan.

segments.src: | | Scenario A | Scenario B |
segments.tr: | | Skenario A | Skenario B |

segments.src: | Benchmark plan price (monthly) | $1,200 | $1,300 |
segments.tr: | Harga rencana tolok ukur (bulanan) | $1,200 | $1,300 |

segments.src: | Expected household contribution | $400 | $450 |
segments.tr: | Diharapkan kontribusi rumah tangga | $400 | $450 |

segments.src: | Premium tax credit | $800 | $850 |
segments.tr: | Kredit pajak premi | $800 | $850 |

segments.src: In this example the benchmark price rises by $100, and the household's expected contribution also rises because the formula or income changed.
segments.tr: Dalam contoh ini harga tolok ukur naik sebesar $100, dan kontribusi rumah tangga yang diharapkan juga naik karena formula atau pendapatan berubah.

segments.src: Even with a larger credit, the family pays $50 more per month.
segments.tr: Bahkan dengan kredit yang lebih besar, keluarga membayar $50 lebih per bulan.

segments.src: Your own result depends on your income, ages, location and the plans available.
segments.tr: Hasil Anda sendiri bergantung pada pendapatan, usia, lokasi, dan rencana yang tersedia.

segments.src: ## Choosing a metal tier
segments.tr: ## Memilih tingkat logam

segments.src: Marketplace plans are grouped into Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum (Platinum is less common).
segments.tr: Rencana Marketplace dikelompokkan menjadi Perunggu, Perak, Emas, dan Platinum (Platinum lebih jarang).

segments.src: The tiers describe how costs are split between you and the insurer on average, not the quality of care or the doctors you can see.
segments.tr: Tingkat tersebut menjelaskan bagaimana biaya dibagi antara Anda dan perusahaan asuransi rata-rata, bukan kualitas perawatan atau dokter yang dapat Anda lihat.

segments.src: - **Bronze:** Lowest monthly premiums, highest deductibles. Often a fit for people who want protection against a major event and rarely use care. Some Bronze and Catastrophe plans may be compatible with a health savings account, depending on current rules.
segments.tr: - **Perunggu:** Premi bulanan terendah, deductible tertinggi. Seringkali cocok untuk orang yang menginginkan perlindungan terhadap peristiwa besar dan jarang menggunakan perawatan. Beberapa rencana Perunggu dan Bencana mungkin kompatibel dengan tabungan kesehatan, tergantung pada aturan saat ini.

segments.src: - **Silver:** Mid-range premiums. If your income is within the range for cost-sharing reductions (CSRs), Silver plans can carry much lower deductibles and out-of-pocket limits than usual. This benefit is available only on Silver plans purchased through the Marketplace.
segments.tr: - **Perak:** Premi kisaran menengah. Jika pendapatan Anda berada dalam kisaran untuk pengurangan pembagian biaya (CSR), rencana Perak dapat membawa deductible dan batas out-of-pocket yang jauh lebih rendah dari biasanya. Manfaat ini hanya tersedia pada rencana Perak yang dibeli melalui Marketplace.

segments.src: - **Gold:** Higher premiums, lower deductibles and copays. This can make sense for households that expect frequent visits, ongoing prescriptions or a planned procedure.
segments.tr: - **Emas:** Premi lebih tinggi, deductible dan copay lebih rendah. Ini masuk akal untuk rumah tangga yang mengharapkan kunjungan sering, resep berkelanjutan, atau prosedur yang direncanakan.

segments.src: - **Platinum:** Highest premiums and lowest cost sharing where offered.
segments.tr: - **Platinum:** Premi tertinggi dan pembagian biaya terendah di tempat yang ditawarkan.

segments.src: In some areas, a Gold plan can cost close to a Silver plan or even less after subsidies, because of how insurers price Silver plans.
segments.tr: Di beberapa daerah, rencana Emas dapat menelan biaya mendekati rencana Perak atau bahkan lebih sedikit setelah subsidi, karena bagaimana perusahaan asuransi menetapkan harga rencana Perak.

segments.src: Always compare the post-subsidy price for each tier rather than assuming Bronze is cheapest in total.
segments.tr: Selalu bandingkan harga pasca-subsidi untuk setiap tingkat daripada mengasumsikan Perunggu adalah yang termurah secara total.

segments.src: ## What to compare before the deadline
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus dibandingkan sebelum tenggat waktu

segments.src: Premium alone does not capture the full cost of coverage.
segments.tr: Premi saja tidak menangkap biaya penuh cakupan.

segments.src: Before you choose, compare:
segments.tr: Sebelum Anda memilih, bandingkan:

segments.src: - **Monthly premium after the tax credit.** Use the exchange's window-shopping or plan comparison tool with your estimated income.
segments.tr: - **Premi bulanan setelah kredit pajak.** Gunakan jendela belanja bursa atau alat perbandingan rencana dengan perkiraan pendapatan Anda.

segments.src: - **Deductible and out-of-pocket maximum.** The out-of-pocket limit is the most you would pay in covered, in-network care in a year.
segments.tr: - **Deductible dan maksimum out-of-pocket.** Batas out-of-pocket adalah yang paling banyak Anda bayar dalam perawatan tercakup dalam jaringan dalam setahun.

segments.src: - **Copays and coinsurance** for primary care, specialists, urgent care and emergency visits.
segments.tr: - **Copay dan coinsurance** untuk perawatan primer, spesialis, perawatan mendesak, dan kunjungan darurat.

segments.src: - **Provider network.** Confirm that your doctors, hospitals and pharmacies are in-network. Check directly with the provider's office, since online directories can be out of date.
segments.tr: - **Jaringan penyedia.** Konfirmasikan bahwa dokter, rumah sakit, dan apotek Anda berada di jaringan. Periksa langsung dengan kantor penyedia, karena direktori online bisa kedaluwarsa.

segments.src: - **Prescription drug formulary.** Look up each medication, its tier and any prior-authorization requirement.
segments.tr: - **Formularium obat resep.** Cari setiap obat, tingkatnya, dan persyaratan pra-otorisasi.

segments.src: - **Cost-sharing reductions.** If your income may qualify, compare Silver plans with CSRs against other tiers.
segments.tr: - **Pengurangan pembagian biaya.** Jika pendapatan Anda mungkin memenuhi syarat, bandingkan rencana Perak dengan CSR terhadap tingkat lainnya.

segments.src: - **Plan type.** HMOs, PPOs and EPOs differ in referral rules and out-of-network coverage.
segments.tr: - **Jenis rencana.** HMO, PPO, dan EPO berbeda dalam aturan rujukan dan cakupan luar jaringan.

segments.src: - **Family needs.** Consider dental and vision for children, maternity care, mental health services and any expected procedures.
segments.tr: - **Kebutuhan keluarga.** Pertimbangkan gigi dan penglihatan untuk anak-anak, perawatan bersalin, layanan kesehatan mental, dan prosedur yang diharapkan.

segments.src: ## Getting your income estimate right
segments.tr: ## Mendapatkan perkiraan pendapatan Anda dengan benar

segments.src: Subsidies are calculated on projected household income for the coverage year.
segments.tr: Subsidi dihitung dari perkiraan pendapatan rumah tangga untuk tahun pertanggungan.

segments.src: If you underestimate, you may have to repay part of the credit at tax time.
segments.tr: Jika Anda meremehkan, Anda mungkin harus membayar kembali bagian dari kredit pada waktu pajak.

segments.src: If you overestimate, you may pay more per month than needed, though you can recover the difference when you file.
segments.tr: Jika Anda melebih-lebihkan, Anda mungkin membayar lebih per bulan daripada yang diperlukan, meskipun Anda dapat memulihkan selisihnya saat Anda mengajukan.

segments.src: Gig workers, the self-employed and people with irregular hours should review their projections carefully and update their application if income changes during the year.
segments.tr: Pekerja gig, wiraswasta, dan orang-orang dengan jam kerja tidak teratur harus meninjau perkiraan mereka dengan cermat dan memperbarui aplikasi mereka jika pendapatan berubah selama tahun ini.

segments.src: Also confirm who counts in your tax household, since that affects eligibility and the size of any credit.
segments.tr: Juga konfirmasikan siapa yang dihitung dalam rumah tangga pajak Anda, karena itu mempengaruhi kelayakan dan ukuran kredit apa pun.

segments.src: ## Key dates and practical steps
segments.tr: ## Tanggal penting dan langkah praktis

segments.src: - **November 1:** Open enrollment begins for 2027 coverage. Window shopping may be available earlier on some sites.
segments.tr: - **1 November:** Pendaftaran terbuka dimulai untuk pertanggungan 2027. Belanja jendela mungkin tersedia lebih awal di beberapa situs.

segments.src: - **Deadlines:** Federal rules have recently changed the length of open enrollment, and some provisions have been the subject of legal challenges. Many exchanges close in mid-December for coverage that starts January 1, while some state exchanges run into January. Check your exchange's published dates, and do not assume last year's deadline still applies.
segments.tr: - **Tenggat waktu:** Aturan federal baru-baru ini mengubah panjang pendaftaran terbuka, dan beberapa ketentuan telah menjadi subjek tantangan hukum. Banyak bursa tutup pada pertengahan Desember untuk pertanggungan yang dimulai 1 Januari, sementara beberapa bursa negara bagian berjalan hingga Januari. Periksa tanggal yang dipublikasikan bursa Anda, dan jangan berasumsi tenggat waktu tahun lalu masih berlaku.

segments.src: - **Existing enrollees:** Review your renewal notice even if you plan to keep your plan. Plans can change prices, networks and formularies, and automatic renewal may not choose the best option for you.
segments.tr: - **Peserta yang ada:** Tinjau pemberitahuan pembaruan Anda bahkan jika Anda berencana untuk mempertahankan rencana Anda. Rencana dapat mengubah harga, jaringan, dan formularium, dan pembaruan otomatis mungkin tidak memilih opsi terbaik untuk Anda.

segments.src: - **After the deadline:** Outside open enrollment, you generally need a qualifying life event, such as losing other coverage, marriage, the birth of a child or a move, to enroll. Medicaid and the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) accept applications year-round if you qualify.
segments.tr: - **Setelah tenggat waktu:** Di luar pendaftaran terbuka, Anda umumnya memerlukan peristiwa kehidupan yang memenuhi syarat, seperti kehilangan cakupan lain, pernikahan, kelahiran anak, atau pindah, untuk mendaftar. Medicaid dan Program Asuransi Kesehatan Anak (CHIP) menerima aplikasi sepanjang tahun jika Anda memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: ## Where to get help
segments.tr: ## Di mana mendapatkan bantuan

segments.src: Free, trained assistance is available.
segments.tr: Bantuan gratis dan terlatih tersedia.

segments.src: Navigators, certified application counselors and licensed agents and brokers can help you compare plans and complete an application.
segments.tr: Navigator, konselor aplikasi bersertifikat, serta agen dan broker berlisensi dapat membantu Anda membandingkan rencana dan menyelesaikan aplikasi.

segments.src: Use the official exchange website, such as HealthCare.gov or your state's exchange, to find local help.
segments.tr: Gunakan situs web bursa resmi, seperti HealthCare.gov atau bursa negara bagian Anda, untuk menemukan bantuan lokal.

segments.src: Be cautious of unsolicited calls, texts or ads promising free or guaranteed coverage, and never share personal or financial information with anyone you cannot verify.
segments.tr: Berhati-hatilah terhadap panggilan, teks, atau iklan yang tidak diminta yang menjanjikan cakupan gratis atau dijamin, dan jangan pernah membagikan informasi pribadi atau keuangan kepada siapa pun yang tidak dapat Anda verifikasi.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: Your 2027 cost will come down to your plan's price, your subsidy and the tier you choose.
segments.tr: Biaya 2027 Anda akan turun ke harga rencana Anda, subsidi Anda, dan tingkat yang Anda pilih.

segments.src: Start early, compare the post-subsidy price and the full cost-sharing picture for each option, verify your doctors and prescriptions, and check your exchange's exact deadline.
segments.tr: Mulai lebih awal, bandingkan harga pasca-subsidi dan gambaran pembagian biaya penuh untuk setiap opsi, verifikasi dokter dan resep Anda, dan periksa tenggat waktu tepat bursa Anda.

segments.src: A few extra minutes of comparison can make a meaningful difference in what your family pays across the year.
segments.tr: Beberapa menit tambahan perbandingan dapat membuat perbedaan berarti dalam apa yang dibayar keluarga Anda sepanjang tahun.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and does not constitute insurance, tax or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini untuk informasi umum saja dan bukan merupakan nasihat asuransi, pajak, atau hukum.

segments.src: Figures in examples are illustrative.
segments.tr: Angka-angka dalam contoh bersifat ilustratif.

segments.src: Consult your exchange, a licensed professional or a tax adviser about your specific situation.*
segments.tr: Konsultasikan dengan bursa Anda, profesional berlisensi, atau penasihat pajak tentang situasi spesifik Anda.*
